description: Pinned, source-cited manifest of CMS-HCC coefficients and factors used by the RAF calculation engine. Any drift between this manifest and the values actually applied at runtime MUST be caught by tests/test_raf_manifest_parity.py. Updating this file requires a paired PR to the test fixture and the upstream source URL/hash.

cms_2026_final_rate_announcement.title: CY2026 Medicare Advantage and Part D Final Rate Announcement

hccinfhir.note: Coefficients delegated to this third-party library. This manifest pins the publicly documented CMS PY2026 values and the constrained-family invariants; unit tests verify hccinfhir still honors them.

2026.source: CMS CY2026 Final Rate Announcement — 100% V28

2024.source: CMS CY2024 Final Rate Announcement — PACE 100% legacy

2025.source: CMS CY2025 Final Rate Announcement — PACE 100% legacy

2026.source: CMS CY2026 Final Rate Announcement — PACE 90/10 blend

2027.source: CMS CY2026 Advance Notice — PACE 50/50 proposed

v28.source: CMS CY2026 Final Rate Announcement, 2024 CMS-HCC model normalization factor

v24.source: CMS CY2026 Final Rate Announcement, 2020 CMS-HCC model normalization factor

v22_legacy_2017.source: CMS CY2026 Final Rate Announcement, 2017 CMS-HCC model normalization factor

v28.source: Statutory MA Coding Intensity Adjustment minimum (Social Security Act §1853(a)(1)(C)(ii)(II)); CMS confirmed 5.9% for CY2026

v28_constrained_families.description: HCCs within each family must share identical segment coefficients per CMS CY2026 V28 specification.

diabetes.note: HCC 35 (pancreas transplant status) is NOT in the constrained group.
diabetes.source: CMS CY2026 Final Rate Announcement, Attachment VI — V28 model coefficients; AAPC V28 guidance 2024
